profile.headline: Senior AI/ML & Backend Engineer | AI Architect | LLM Platform & Inference | Generative AI | ML Infrastructure | Model Serving | Distributed Systems & Cloud
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer – AI & Backend Architecture
profile.summary:
I build the infrastructure that turns advanced AI capabilities into reliable, scalable production systems.

With 10+ years of software engineering experience, I’ve built high-throughput backend and AI systems across Generative AI, LLM infrastructure, machine learning, distributed systems, fintech, healthcare, and cloud platforms.

My work focuses on moving AI from experimentation into production—building LLM orchestration, model serving, GPU inference, RAG systems, backend services, cloud infrastructure, and observability with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, and performance.

At Starbucks, I work on AI and backend architecture, building production LLM applications, inference workflows, RAG pipelines, and AI orchestration services using FastAPI, Spring Boot, LangChain, LlamaIndex, PyTorch, Hugging Face, Triton, Kafka, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, and vector databases.

Previously at Optum, I worked on ambient clinical intelligence and scalable ML inference infrastructure using Ray Serve, vLLM, Hugging Face, PyTorch, Kubernetes, and GPU infrastructure, with healthcare integrations including FHIR and HL7.

At Hugging Face, I worked on Inference Endpoints and ML infrastructure, focusing on model deployment, serving, orchestration, autoscaling, resource management, and production inference. Earlier at Stripe and Uber, I built backend and distributed systems for financial infrastructure, high-volume event processing, observability and distributed tracing.

Core expertise:
• LLM inference, model serving, distributed inference, and GPU infrastructure
• Generative AI, LLM applications, AI orchestration, and AI agents
• RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic retrieval
• Distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures
• Python, Go, Java, FastAPI, Spring Boot, Ray, Ray Serve, vLLM, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers
• Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, CI/CD, Linux, AWS, Azure, and cloud-native infrastructure
• Kafka, Redis, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL, and data systems
• Observability, distributed tracing, performance optimization, reliability, and fault-tolerant systems

I approach AI engineering as production software engineering. Strong AI systems need more than capable models—they need scalable infrastructure, reliable APIs, efficient inference, observability, secure data flows, and architecture that can evolve with the product.

I enjoy working across AI, infrastructure, and backend engineering, collaborating with engineering, ML, data science, and product teams to solve complex problems and deliver practical systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer – AI & Backend Architecture
positions.description:
Owned end-to-end architecture and delivery of production LLM orchestration, RAG, and real-time AI platforms.

Key contributions:
• Architected scalable FastAPI and Spring Boot microservices for LLM orchestration using LangChain and LlamaIndex.
• Built high-throughput LLM inference and model-serving workflows with PyTorch, Hugging Face, Triton Inference Server, Docker, and Kubernetes.
• Designed event-driven RAG pipelines with Apache Kafka, embeddings, and vector databases including Pinecone, Milvus, and pgvector.
• Developed scalable REST and gRPC APIs for AI orchestration, data processing, and service-to-service communication.
• Deployed AI workloads across AWS EKS and Azure AKS, implementing secure infrastructure, IAM, networking, autoscaling, and reliability controls.
• Implemented LLM workload routing, dynamic batching, agentic workflows, and autoscaling with LangGraph and distributed inference components.
• Established production observability and evaluation for latency, token usage, retrieval quality, model performance, and system reliability using Prometheus, Grafana, and Weights & Biases.
• Partnered with Data Science, Backend, and MLOps teams to move AI systems from development through production.

positions.title: Senior ML Engineer
positions.description:
Led backend architecture and ML platform delivery for CareScribe, an enterprise ambient clinical intelligence platform supporting AI-assisted clinical documentation.

Key contributions:
 • Led the design and implementation of backend architecture for high-throughput LLM inference and clinical documentation workflows under HIPAA requirements.
 • Architected and productionized distributed GPU inference using Python, Ray Serve, vLLM, Hugging Face, and Kubernetes.
 • Designed inference infrastructure with workload routing, GPU resource management, autoscaling, and concurrency controls to support production clinical workloads.
 • Developed secure, OpenAI-compatible streaming APIs for real-time clinician-facing AI applications and GenAI workflows.
 • Built and operated cloud infrastructure across Azure AKS and AWS GPU environments, with secure networking, data isolation, and production reliability controls.
 • Designed RAG and semantic retrieval pipelines connecting clinical knowledge sources, embeddings, vector search, and LLM services.
 • Established MLOps and deployment automation with containerized releases, CI/CD, health checks, rollback strategies, and production observability.
 • Collaborated with ML, backend, and platform teams to improve inference performance, deployment reliability, and system scalability.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · MLOps · Ray Serve · Software Design · Fine Tuning · Microsoft Azure · Kubernetes · Software Development · Natural Language Processing (NLP) · Graphics Processing Unit · vLLM · Inference Optimization · GPU Inference · Software Industry · PyTorch · Ray / Ray Serve · LLM Evaluation · Large Language Model Operations (LLMOps) · Distributed Inference · Hugging Face Transformers · Software Systems Engineering

positions.title: Senior Backend Engineer
positions.description:
Built backend infrastructure for Inference Endpoints, enabling enterprise teams to deploy, scale, and operate machine learning models as production services.

Key contributions:
 •Developed Go and Python backend services for model deployment, endpoint lifecycle management, and infrastructure orchestration.
 •Built scalable model-serving infrastructure supporting high-throughput and multi-tenant ML inference workloads.
 •Designed resource management, workload orchestration, autoscaling, and deployment automation for production inference environments.
 •Developed reliable inference APIs with request routing, asynchronous processing, batching, and streaming capabilities.
 •Integrated Kubernetes, Redis, Docker, and cloud infrastructure to operate distributed model-serving workloads at scale.
 •Built reusable platform components that streamlined how engineering teams package, deploy, and manage ML models in production.
 •Partnered with ML, infrastructure, and platform engineers to improve deployment reliability, inference performance, and developer experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Linux · Machine Learning · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Docker · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Auto Scaling · Microsoft Azure · Kubernetes · Terraform · Resource Management · Workload Routing · Software Industry · Cloud Computing · Batching · Software Systems Engineering

positions.title: Backend Engineer
positions.description:
Built backend infrastructure for high-volume financial systems, with a strong focus on correctness, consistency, and reliability at scale.

Key contributions:
 •Developed backend services using Java, Ruby, Kafka, and Redis for high-volume financial workflows.
 •Contributed to Stripe Ledger, supporting transaction processing, account state management, and financial data consistency.
 •Designed event-driven transaction workflows for processing financial events and coordinating downstream services.
 •Implemented distributed locking and coordination mechanisms to safely handle concurrent financial operations.
 •Built bank reconciliation workflows with a strong emphasis on accuracy, idempotency, and data consistency.
 •Optimized Kafka-based streaming pipelines and backend APIs supporting high-volume financial events.
 •Implemented fault tolerance, observability, distributed tracing, and operational diagnostics across production services.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · REST APIs · Microservices · Backend Development · Apache Kafka · Java

positions.title: Backend Developer
positions.description:
Worked on distributed backend infrastructure and observability systems, helping engineering teams monitor and troubleshoot large-scale microservices.

Key contributions:
 •Developed backend components for Jaeger, focusing on high-throughput distributed trace ingestion and processing.
 •Built Go services for collecting, processing, and managing large volumes of tracing data.
 •Designed event-driven processing pipelines using Apache Kafka for scalable trace ingestion and data flow.
 •Implemented scalable trace storage and search using Cassandra and Elasticsearch.
 •Improved the scalability, reliability, and performance of distributed tracing infrastructure supporting production microservices.
 •Contributed to telemetry pipelines that transformed operational events into searchable, analytics-ready datasets.
 •Collaborated with backend and infrastructure teams on distributed systems, microservices, and production observability.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Distributed Systems · Cassandra · Elasticsearch · Software Development · Apache Kafka · Event-driven · Go · Apache Spark
